Gondorian plate-harness: blackened-steel cuirass etched with the White Tree, articulated pauldrons, riveted gorget, dented vambraces, mail-skirted faulds, mud-caked greaves — a ranger-captain's armor worn through a dozen sieges, half-cape of charcoal wool pinned at one shoulder.

Witcher-school reinforced leather cuirass, wolf-medallion pressed into the chest-plate, studded pauldrons, tooled bracers with silver-wire inlay, hide-and-mail composite over a padded gambeson, twin sword-harness across the back, road-grey and storm-scarred.

Nord berserker half-plate: riveted iron breastplate over a chainmail hauberk, bone-carved pauldrons, battered vambraces, fur-lined gorget, every surface frost-pitted and axe-notched — Skyrim tundra grime ground into every seam, a wolf-pelt drape across one shoulder.

Nilfgaardian sun-plate: fitted blacksteel cuirass with sun-burst relief, articulated spaulders, full vambraces, articulated greaves, gorget — parade-perfect silhouette now campaign-scarred, lacquered black showing bare steel beneath every dent, a short slate-grey campaign cloak buckled at the collar.

Half-orc warlord brigandine: heavy riveted plates over a leather-and-mail foundation, asymmetric pauldrons — one iron slab, one layered scale — brass-studded bracers, banded greaves, every rivet hammered by orcish hand, rust-orange battle-stains across the chest.

Mahakaman dwarven lamellar: overlapping blackened-iron lamellae wired to a leather backing, forming a squat barrel-chest cuirass, shoulder-caps of hammered bronze, etched runes along every plate-edge, battered shin-guards, the whole suit smelling of forge-smoke and stone-dust.

Dunedain ranger mail: riveted mithril-washed hauberk under a dark-oiled leather cuirass, pauldrons of banded steel, hide bracers with blade-grommets, knee-high weathered greaves, a forest-green half-cape frayed at the hem — every piece shaped for silence on long wilderness roads.

Drow exile scout-leather: chitin-and-hide cuirass reinforced with underdark beetle-shell plates, shoulder-harness holding two curved blades, tooled bracers with spider-silk lacing, matte-black and deep violet — fitted for silence, no pauldrons to scrape stone, collar-wrap of shadow-grey linen.

Quel'Thalas blood-knight plate: crimson-lacquered cuirass with gold-chased sunfire etchings, articulated pauldrons spreading like phoenix wings, engraved vambraces, slim greaves, gorget — mana-scarred and battle-cracked across the left chest-panel, a blood-red half-cape snapping at the hip.

Rohirrim cavalry plate: hammered bronze breastplate over a riveted mail shirt, horse-head-embossed pauldrons, leather-backed vambraces, greaves shaped to the saddle — all gold-brown patina now mud-stained, a torn cavalry pennon knotted at the belt.

Runed battlemage coat-armor: fitted dark-iron plate segments sewn to a heavy canvas-and-leather coat, arcane sigils engraved and glowing faint amber, vambrace-mounted focus-rings, gorget, no flowing hem — martial silhouette, boots armored to the knee, short sorcerer's collar.

Elden Ring tarnished crucible-plate: verdigris-bronze cuirass with writhing crucible-horn reliefs, articulated pauldrons, mail-fringed faulds, scarred gauntlets, greaves webbed with old root-like etchings — golden-age grandeur stripped to battlefield grime, a shredded amber wool cloak tied at the right shoulder.

Dragon Age Grey Warden composite: darkspawn-ichor-stained breastplate over banded brigandine, mismatched pauldrons salvaged from two different suits, scarred vambraces, studded leather greaves, heavy gorget — functionality over ceremony, a short charcoal cloak bearing the faded Warden griffon.

Rohirric outrider leather-and-plate: reinforced studded-leather cuirass, scale-shoulder cap on the sword-arm, tooled hide bracers, banded leather greaves, a mail coif folded at the collar — wind-cracked and sun-bleached to pale tan, twin short-swords sheathed crossed at the back.

Khorne-adjacent chaos-warrior plate: grotesque blacksteel cuirass welded from mismatched battle-trophies, asymmetric demon-faced pauldrons, spiked vambraces, articulated greaves — every surface corroded and battle-gouged, a scalp of enemy chainmail hanging as trophy, no cloak — armor speaks alone.

Arcane-plate battlemage: segmented obsidian plate cuirass with electrum runic channels, pauldrons mounted with tiny orrery rings, vambraces etched with containment sigils, gorget, close-fitted — spell-burned scoring across the breastplate, knee-high armored boots, no robe, a rigid scholars collar of dark iron.

Cataphract-inspired heavy plate: scale-over-mail cuirass of gilded iron, full articulated pauldrons, elbow-to-wrist vambraces, tall greaves, lamellar faulds — desert-campaign-yellowed and lance-scarred, a red sash tied tight at the waist beneath the cuirass as the sole fabric accent.

Dwarven miner-turned-warrior brigandine: coal-black iron-plate brigandine, each plate hand-stamped with clan-runes, reinforced elbow caps, heavy buckled bracers, plated kneecap greaves — short and dense silhouette, a canvas under-shirt sealed beneath the plates, beard braided with iron rings.

Witcher-school bear reinforced leather: thick hide cuirass stitched with iron-cap rivets, massive fur-trimmed pauldrons, scarred vambraces, knee-high studded boots, a chest-harness carrying a great-axe — school-bear crest burned into the breast leather, oiled dark brown and salt-stained.

Dúnedain lore-knight runed-leather over mail: slate-grey hauberk beneath a fitted tooled-leather cuirass bearing Tengwar border-etchings, narrow pauldrons, scholar-bracers with silver clasp, slim greaves — the mail showing at the collar and cuffs, a hooded half-cape of deep blue wool, weathered to near-black.

Ferelden hinterlands mercenary scale: riveted iron-scale cuirass over a padded gambeson, asymmetric shoulder-plate on the shield-arm, hide bracers, banded-steel greaves — every scale individually dented, one replaced with a copper substitute, a sheepskin half-cape belted across the chest in winter-country style.

Orc ironclad plate: oversized blacksteel breastplate hammered thick and crude, massive flanged pauldrons, vambraces as wide as most men's thighs, articulated tusk-guard gorget — surface beaten with war-hammer impressions intentionally, battle-trophies riveted as decoration, a torn hide cape barely reaching mid-back.

High-elf sentinel plate: moonsilver cuirass with leaf-vein filigree channeling faint blue light, slender articulated pauldrons, elegant vambraces, shin-length greaves — ancient and immaculate except for one long blade-scar across the breastplate, a winter-white half-cloak pinned with an emerald leaf-brooch.

Inquisitor runed-leather battlemage: fitted dark-crimson leather cuirass reinforced with iron-sewn plates, arcane ward-runes burned along the chest and shoulders, close pauldrons, wrist-guards holding scroll-tubes, armored boots — a short mandarin collar of stiff leather, no flowing overcoat, silhouette lean and militant.

Stormcoast marauder chitin-and-hide: coastal-black chitin plates over a salt-hardened hide cuirass, barnacle-textured pauldrons, heavy buckled vambraces, banded greaves — sea-voyage grime in every seam, a harpoon-hook tool-harness across the chest, a short waxed-canvas half-cape stiff with ocean spray.

Gondorian heavy infantry: fitted black-steel breastplate over riveted mail hauberk, articulated pauldrons and vambraces engraved with White Tree, dented gorget, greaves mud-streaked. Wool gambeson beneath. Battle-worn scarlet half-cape pinned at one shoulder.

Witcher School-of-Wolf: weathered wolf-hide reinforced cuirass over padded gambeson, studded leather spaulders, tooled vambraces bearing wolf-head sigils, road-grime on every seam. Twin steel sword hilts rising above shoulders.

Nord berserker: hand-forged blackened-iron breastplate riveted over a thick wool-and-chain hauberk, bear-fur mantle draped one shoulder, runic-etched pauldrons, dented iron greaves. Frost-cracked leather bracers lashed tight.

Nilfgaardian black-sun knight: obsidian-lacquered articulated full plate, sun-burst etched breastplate, close-fitting gorget, articulated gauntlets, coal-black half-cape. Every joint burnished to mirror-dark finish, scratched from campaign.

Drow shadow-ranger: chitin-and-darksteel cuirass over tightly-fitted mail, spider-silk underlayer beneath closed collar, notched obsidian-plated pauldrons, slim greaves. Poisoned-blade shoulder harness, night-black half-cloak edged in violet.

Mahakaman dwarven ironclad: squat but fierce lamellar breastplate of overlapping iron-and-bronze scales, heavy brass-riveted brigandine beneath, stubby articulated vambraces, engraved gorget. Axe-scored helmet tucked under arm.

Rohirrim outrider: horse-lord fitted scale cuirass over padded gambeson, hammered-iron pauldrons, tooled leather vambraces with horse-head stamps, mud-flecked greaves. Tattered golden half-cape at back.

Dunedain ranger-lord: scarred dark-leather reinforced cuirass over close-fitting chainmail hauberk, shoulder-harness with sheathed hunting knife, tooled bracers, travel-worn hood folded back. Silver star-brooch at throat.

Blood-elf battlemage: fitted arcane-plate breastplate of crimson-and-gold over reinforced runed-leather underlayer, slim articulated vambraces inscribed with sin'dorei glyphs, gorget, greaves. Martial coat-hem barely grazes the knee.

Half-orc warchief: massive chitin-and-iron composite breastplate bolted over thick hide hauberk, jagged bone-reinforced pauldrons, heavy vambraces, brass-riveted greaves. Campaign trophies lashed to belt.

Elden Ring crucible knight: verdigris-streaked antlered plate cuirass over ancient mail hauberk, articulated pauldrons bearing crucible engravings, gorget, battered greaves. Mossy surface implies centuries of duty.

Skyrim Stormcloak captain: nord-iron fitted breastplate over thick wool-padded gambeson, bear-hide mantle at one shoulder, riveted vambraces, iron greaves. Battered blue-and-silver half-cape, road-soaked.

Witcher School-of-Cat: slim reinforced studded-leather cuirass over snug gambeson, lightweight pauldrons of layered hide, tooled bracers, cat-fang amulet. Two slender curved blades sheathed crosswise at back.

Bretonnian grail knight: white-and-azure fitted plate breastplate over mail hauberk, fleur-de-lis etched pauldrons, articulated gauntlets, gorget. Faded blue tournament half-cape, mud-hem, battered but noble.

Quel'Thalas high-elf warden: slender gilded-bronze lamellar cuirass over silk-and-chain underlayer, leaf-etched articulated vambraces, close gorget, fine greaves. Emerald-clasped half-cloak, arrows of enchanted ashwood at hip.

Dragonborn dovahkiin: dragonscale breastplate of crimson-black scales riveted to iron frame over mail gambeson, articulated pauldrons, dented greaves. Scorched bone-crest atop battered helm, ash-grey half-cape.

Iron Islands reaver: saltwater-corroded hauberk of riveted chainmail beneath a battered iron breastplate, heavy leather spaulders, scarred vambraces, kraken-etched gorget. Damp half-cape of dark wool.

Kul Tiran sailor-knight: barnacle-scarred heavy breastplate over layered brigandine coat, anchor-embossed pauldrons, thick iron vambraces, canvas-padded gambeson beneath. Waxed storm-cloak tied at one shoulder.
Southron desert knight: brass-and-copper articulated cuirass over fine mail hauberk, pauldrons with sun-disc ornaments, carved bracers, light greaves. Sand-pale linen wrapped at neck against heat.

Arcane battlemage: fitted runed-steel breastplate over stiffened leather battlemage coat, close-cut collar, articulated vambraces covered in etched sigils, slim greaves. No robes — martial silhouette, glowing rune at sternum.
